text: The dentist was gentle and lovely, and gave excellent advice. However, after the extraction and the dentist had stitches on the inside of my gums, I was a bit disoriented and couldn't speak clearly. The staff at the counter weren't very polite. I asked them to explain the medication and how to use the gauze again, and they asked if I hadn't heard them. I was a little surprised, and they explained it again with a displeased expression and made faces at me. The dentist did a great job 💯, but one visit is enough 🥹. I had a very unpleasant experience with the staff.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมน้องปลื้ม
text: The doctor was very gentle, communicative, explained every step of the process, and paid attention to detail. The price was reasonable and affordable. The nurses at the counter were also very friendly and helpful. If you live near Thalang, I highly recommend this place. It's located in front of Phuket Thani Village.

text: I had this done several years ago to have my teeth scaled. For me, it was fine, but my mother had some of her teeth scaled off, and she could feel the difference before and after. This has resulted in her not being able to brush her teeth normally, and her teeth are falling out one by one, making daily life very difficult.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมน้องปลื้ม
text:
After having my tooth extracted, I experienced severe pain for two weeks, and it hadn't subsided. I had to buy medicine from the pharmacy. Even after the wound and pain subsided, the pain persisted.
I couldn't open my mouth to eat, and my jaw hurt when I yawned. It's been a month now, and it's still hurting. 🙄🙄🙄🙄😓😓

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมน้องปลื้ม
text:
This was the most painful teeth scaling I've ever had.
It was also more expensive than any other time. Normally it's no more than 900 baht, but this time it cost 1200 baht. The tools were inconsistent, and I got almost completely soaked.
This will probably be the last time I get my teeth done here…
(My whole family used to get their teeth done here, but we won't be anymore.)

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมน้องปลื้ม
text:
I would like to file a complaint based on the facts I encountered:

- The staff were impolite and spoke over the heads of customers (this was the second time I used their service, and the behavior was the same).

- The equipment was not as good as it should have been.

- On my most recent visit, there was no explanation of the materials used or what the customer preferred.

- The price was unreasonable.
